verdict.rationale: Polar documents a versioned API reference and serves OpenAPI 3.1 specs from its docs site, so an API reference exists. Nothing in the pack shows it is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. The root-level OpenAPI probe 404s refer to different paths than the docs-hosted specs, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
